The verified knowledge indicates that The Transformer architecture replaces recurrent architectures with Multi-Head Self-Attention. Attention weights are computed as the scaled dot-product between query (Q) and key (K) matrices divided by the square root of the head dimension dk, followed by softmax and multiplication with value (V) matrices.
